# Copilot instructions for Beb Games

- Use the project root as the working directory.
- Prioritize a simple and reliable web app for a computer store.
- Keep the application easy to run locally with Node.js and Express.
- Support login, catalog management, configurable profit margin, customer management, and quote generation.
- Persist data locally in JSON files so no external database is required for the first version.
- Favor readable code and practical business logic for a small retail operation.
